unit: Source sentence, interpreted in its original paragraph/article context
selection_method: Contextual LLM review; purposeful sample, not random or exhaustive.
scope: Includes explicitly pro-Palestinian/pro-Israel movements with exact targets recorded, as requested.
limitations: The narrator/source distinction is not a personal-belief attribution.
Neutral describes absence of explicit approval/disapproval of the target, not an absence of distress or violence in the situation.
Quoting a source does not mean the author endorses the source.
A source accusation is not an independently verified fact.
A sentence can mention the other party as speaker, location, background, or recipient; the label follows its primary portrayal target. Inseparable portrayals of both sides are not selected.
Movements and armed groups are not interchangeable with civilian populations. Jewish identity alone is not treated as pro-Israel affiliation.
These labels are proposed, not independently validated; no measured accuracy or numerical confidence is claimed.
The sample and missing outlets cannot support an unbiased comparison of publisher bias.
Sentence segmentation was refined to split quoted multi-sentence passages and protect common abbreviations, so T IDs differ from the earlier author-opinion S IDs.
